title: Homology of the explicit additive Cech augmentations
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact separated scheme and U a finite open covering with every positive-length tuple intersection affine. Let I be any injective resolution of the lifted additive structure sheaf and n a nonnegative degree. Using the global, total and ordinary unit Cech complexes and alpha/beta components of [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization], there exist additive equivalences p from global resolution homology to total homology and q from ordinary unit Cech homology to total homology. Every global cycle and every ordinary Cech cycle has a total cycle whose underlying cochain is respectively its alpha or beta image. For any such lifted cycle t, p sends the global cycle class to [t], respectively q sends the Cech cycle class to [t]. These conditions determine both equivalences uniquely and make no assertion about Ext or independence of resolutions.

source.place: Lemma 20.15.1, augmented double-complex diagram; Tag 03P2, Theorem 59.22.4, separated affine-cover argument.

proof.text: Use the alpha restriction quasi-isomorphism with its exact components. Take the additive equivalence induced by its homology map. cyclesMap lifts each cycle and cyclesMap_i identifies its cochain with alpha.
Use the beta additive cycle lift and bijective additive homology map. Turn that bijective homomorphism into an additive equivalence using AddEquiv.ofBijective.

For any total cycle with the prescribed cochain, injectivity of iCycles identifies it with the canonical lift. homologyπ_naturality gives the alpha formula, and the beta homology descent formula gives the beta formula. Package the two equivalences and the four clauses.

proof_origin.place: Alpha and beta comparison followed by cycle inclusion injectivity and homology quotient naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_additiveCech_augmentation_homology
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : (additiveCechGlobal I).homology n ≃+ (additiveCechTotal U I).homology n,
    ∃ q : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homology n ≃+
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homology n,
      (∀ s : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n,
        ∃ t : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n,
          (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n t =
            additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s)) ∧
      (∀ z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n,
        ∃ t : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n,
          (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n t = additiveCechBeta U I n
            ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z)) ∧
      (∀ (s : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n) (t : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n),
        (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n t =
          additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s) →
        p ((additiveCechGlobal I).homologyπ n s) =
          (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n t) ∧
      (∀ (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
        (t : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n),
        (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n t = additiveCechBeta U I n
          ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z) →
        q ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homologyπ n z) =
          (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n t)
